gloss: wrong prediction; unexpected outcome; contrary to expectations

definitions.gloss: wrong prediction; unexpected outcome; contrary to expectations
definitions.explanation: When the actual result differs from what was predicted or expected. Can describe a pleasant or unpleasant surprise.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}は{予想違|よそうちが}いだった。
examples.english: The result was contrary to expectations.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}が{予想違|よそうちが}いで{雨|あめ}になった。
examples.english: The weather turned out differently than expected and it rained.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}の{結果|けっか}は{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}にとって{予想違|よそうちが}いで、{野党|やとう}が{大勝|たいしょう}した。
examples.english: The election results were unexpected for many people, with the opposition winning a landslide.

notes:
Composed of {予想|よそう} (prediction, expectation) and {違|ちが}い (difference, mistake). Part of a family of ～{違|ちが}い compounds that express something being different from what was intended or expected.

RELATED ～{違|ちが}い COMPOUNDS:
- {見当違|けんとうちが}い: wrong guess, barking up the wrong tree
- {勘違|かんちが}い: misunderstanding, wrong impression
- {場違|ばちが}い: out of place, inappropriate for the setting
- {筋違|すじちが}い: unreasonable, misdirected

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {予想外|よそうがい}: unexpected — similar meaning but used as an adjective/adverb ({予想外|よそうがい}の{展開|てんかい}, unexpected development)
- {期待外|きたいはず}れ: disappointment — specifically when reality falls short of hopes
- {想定外|そうていがい}: beyond assumption — more formal, often used for things that could not have been foreseen
